checks.scope: False sunflower pruning from an unrepresented marker point
checks.method: Read D19-model-bridge.md Sections 1–3 and degree19_projection_v3.py:62–93; independently compared literal intersections.
checks.observation: With cone {13,0,1,2}, marker {0,6,7,12} and residual {0,8,9,12}, omitting point 12 falsely makes projected intersections equal. The source includes point 12. All 41534 comparisons over its 1093 trace types, 19 root cones and two fresh completion sets agree with the full-set predicate, including member distinctness. This tests one marker geometry, not every model.

checks.scope: Illicit propagation from four-set absence to proper traces
checks.method: Read D17-generic-stage-plan.md and check_d17_stage_plan_v9.py:270–332,460–493; executed the unchanged extracted forbidden-trace gate.
checks.observation: A previously absent {0,6,7,8} did not justify forbidding trace {0,6,7}: the gate rejected it. A proved absent proper trace correctly justified both its unmarked and added-marker restrictions. checks.scope: Q8 leaf overlap in Alpha’s cap-14 closure
checks.method: Read LOW14-NO43-ordinary-closure.md; independently exhausted the 64 bipartite graphs on parts of sizes 3 and 2.
checks.observation: All 27 graphs with at least three edges and maximum degree 2 have a disjoint edge pair, yielding the stated sunflower if a Q8 leaf lies in the common triangle. A triangle defeats omitted bipartiteness; a three-edge star defeats omitted degree cap. The source proves both guards before invoking cross-star. Literal results and script are preserved in checks/round07/methodologist/.
